value_text: construct=Enc; variant_status=wild_type; assembly_symmetry=icosahedral; T_number=1; T_number_basis=inferred_from_subunit_count; shell_subunit_count=60; shell_diameter_nm=21; curated_notes=Canonical WT native-cargo-loaded T=1 assembly. Loaded-Enc formed regular nanocompartments approximately 21 nm in diameter. Cryo-EM directly resolved a T=1 icosahedral shell composed of 60 Enc subunits. Asymmetric reconstruction revealed four EncFtn decamers arranged tetrahedrally inside the shell, producing a symmetry mismatch with the icosahedral cage. PDB 7OE2 and 7OEU represent closed and open fivefold-pore pentamer conformations derived from symmetry expansion of this same Loaded-Enc assembly and are therefore handled in pore_records rather than as separate assemblies.
